To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
data streaming algorithms can produce accurate estimation of traffic and flow matrix at high speed.
we propose a novel data stream algorithm that can accurately and efficiently measure traffic and flow matrices, with the ability to handle very high-speed network traffic.

(a) We present a novel data streaming approach for accurate and efficient estimation of traffic and flow matrix, which is orders of magnitude smaller in size than the traffic stream and thus has very low overhead; (b) We establish the principles and techniques of combining this streaming method optimally with sampling; (c) We propose a novel algorithm for estimating flow matrix, which has not been studied in the literature before.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fundamental problem of traffic matrix measurement and estimation.
the design and analysis of novel data streaming algorithms for traffic and flow matrix estimation.

the design of novel data streaming algorithms for accurate estimation of traffic and flow matrix, and the development of efficient techniques for combining these streaming algorithms with sampling, when necessary, to meet resource constraints.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed streaming algorithms can produce accurate estimation of traffic and flow matrix at very high speed, with very small memory and computational overhead.
our algorithms can provide very accurate estimation of the traffic matrix and flow matrices, at a very high processing rate and with a very small memory footprint.
our data streaming algorithms can accurately estimate the traffic matrix and flow matrices, and can be used to complement the existing methods for traffic matrix estimation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed two novel data streaming algorithms for accurate measurement of traffic and/or flow matrices.
the proposed streaming algorithms are very efficient in terms of both time and memory complexity, and can produce accurate estimation of traffic and flow matrix, even when sampling is used.

we propose a novel data stream processing framework for traffic measurement, and demonstrate that this framework is very effective and efficient in estimating traffic and flow matrices in large-scale networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
data streaming is a powerful tool for traffic and flow matrix measurement.
, by processing data streams at very high speeds, the traffic and flow matrices can be measured accurately and efficiently.
data stream processing can be a powerful tool in solving many problems in network measurement and traffic engineering.
